title: Taraxacum officinale tincture for medicinal use
intro: Taraxacum officinale tincture is a concentrated liquid preparation made from the dried leaves and flowers of the common dandelion. It is commonly used in herbalism to support liver function and promote detoxification. This tincture is often taken internally to aid digestion and reduce inflammation. It may also be used externally to treat skin conditions and wounds. Its bitter compounds stimulate the digestive system and enhance overall metabolic processes.
